section.title: Detailed Description
section.para: Defines functions that generate clip space transformation matrices.

The matrices generated by this extension use standard OpenGL fixed-function conventions. For example, the lookAt function generates a transform from world space into the specific eye space that the projective matrix functions (perspective, ortho, etc) are designed to expect. The OpenGL compatibility specifications defines the particular layout of this eye space.
Include <glm/ext/matrix_clip_space.hpp> to use the features of this extension.

section.title: frustum()

para.computeroutput: GLM_FUNC_DECL mat< 4, 4, T, defaultp > glm::frustum (T left, T right, T bottom, T top, T near, T far)

section.para: Creates a frustum matrix with default handedness, using the default handedness and default near and far clip planes definition. To change default handedness use GLM_FORCE_LEFT_HANDED. To change default near and far clip planes definition use GLM_FORCE_DEPTH_ZERO_TO_ONE.

section.title: frustumLH()

para.computeroutput: GLM_FUNC_DECL mat< 4, 4, T, defaultp > glm::frustumLH (T left, T right, T bottom, T top, T near, T far)

section.para: Creates a left-handed frustum matrix. If GLM_FORCE_DEPTH_ZERO_TO_ONE is defined, the near and far clip planes correspond to z normalized device coordinates of 0 and +1 respectively. (Direct3D clip volume definition) Otherwise, the near and far clip planes correspond to z normalized device coordinates of -1 and +1 respectively. (OpenGL clip volume definition)

para.computeroutput: GLM_FUNC_DECL mat< 4, 4, T, defaultp > glm::frustumLH_NO (T left, T right, T bottom, T top, T near, T far)

section.para: Creates a left-handed frustum matrix. The near and far clip planes correspond to z normalized device coordinates of -1 and +1 respectively. (OpenGL clip volume definition)

section.title: infinitePerspective()

para.computeroutput: GLM_FUNC_DECL mat< 4, 4, T, defaultp > glm::infinitePerspective (T fovy, T aspect, T near)

section.para: Creates a matrix for a symmetric perspective-view frustum with far plane at infinite with default handedness.

entry.para: Specifies the field of view angle, in degrees, in the y direction. Expressed in radians.
Specifies the aspect ratio that determines the field of view in the x direction. The aspect ratio is the ratio of x (width) to y (height).
Specifies the distance from the viewer to the near clipping plane (always positive).
